title: Schedule maker and course table tools
lead: Free browser tools: a class schedule maker now, and more student tools later. UBC Workday Excel import is included. Other campuses — SFU, Waterloo, and more — can send a timetable file so we can add it.
seoTitle: Schedule Maker & Course Table Tools | Timetable Craft
seoDescription: Free schedule maker and course table maker in the browser. Open the class timetable tool, or follow the UBC Workday Excel path. Other schools can send a timetable file.
scheduleMakerBody: A free timetable maker for weekly classes. Add courses by hand or import UBC Workday View My Courses Excel, pick what goes on the grid, restyle the card, and export PNG or calendar .ics. Parsing stays on this device.
scheduleMakerSeoTitle: Free Schedule Maker for Classes | Timetable Craft
scheduleMakerSeoDescription: Free schedule maker for weekly classes. Add courses or import UBC Workday Excel, customize your course table, and download a PNG or calendar .ics. No sign-up.
ubcBody: Landing page for UBC schedule maker and UBC course table maker searches: Workday Excel, UBC terms, and registration statuses.
comingSoonBody: The next tools will live here. Schedule Maker is the first — GPA, exam planners, and the rest are still being built.
